integrity: Exact arbitrary-size proof is analytical; separate finite-rational checker tests example laws but is not an infinite proof. The distinction between random-greedy and flat maximal-set sampling is credited as background. Historical comparison uses accessible materials; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Requires simple d-regular C4-free bipartite missing-edge graph, both parts size n, 2<=d<n and continuous iid uniform priority; does not extend to irregular deletions, four-cycles, or other sampling laws. Historical priority has bounded remaining uncertainty.
title: Exact greedy maximal-independent-set laws for dense bipartite complements of \(C_4\)-free regular graphs
